title: eCAD Digital Domain Vocabulary v1
description: The scenarios and closed-form derivations the digital domain adapter implements. The generic requirements schema leaves both open; the digital adapter validates every digital requirement and reference against this document. Every case runs the one Icarus Verilog simulation of the harness written from the model, so a scenario carries only its name.

name.description: loopback: reset, then every byte of the top sent from the transmitter to the receiver over the line, observed until the run's fixed end.

derivation.description: Name of the independent closed-form derivation that computes the expected value from the engineering model. The value itself is computed, not typed.
